name: Shinagawa Claude
source:
A resident of the same apartment building as Shuichi and Nanami.

He is an interior designer who works from home.

He is half-Japanese and half-French, and is a handsome man with a distinctly foreign appearance.

He has a gentlemanly demeanor and maintains a friendly relationship with Shuichi and Nanami as their neighbor.

He sometimes helps them with interior design consultations and occasionally participates alongside them in neighborhood association events.

Shuichi sometimes finds himself secretly jealous when he sees Nanami interacting so amicably with the handsome Shinagawa.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11485]the official site[/url]]
